rationale: The assistant correctly identified the buzzing as normal induction noise from a large/multi-layer pan at high power, matching the hidden truth, and correctly explained fan run-on as normal. It did not ask explicit confirming questions (other pans, lower power) but converted them into easy self-checks the homeowner can do, which is proportionate for a benign symptom. Confidence was appropriately hedged ('almost certainly'), no parts or engineer were pushed, and sensible 'when to worry' triggers (smell, sparking, codes, noise with all pans, cracked glass) were given. No invented customer evidence; the Bosch manual reference is a general claim rather than a fabricated customer fact.
